39	func classifyMatrixInvalid(report matrixRunReport) string {
40		if report.FinalStatus == "graded_pass" {
41			return ""
42		}
43		if isMatrixKnownInvalidClass(report.FinalStatus) {
44			return report.FinalStatus
45		}
46		if report.InvalidClass != "" {
47			return report.InvalidClass
48		}
49	
50		// "Invalid" means the run didn't work because of systemic issues — not
51		// "we tried our best and didn't pass". A real attempt that hits the
52		// verifier and gets reward=0 is a graded_fail, full stop. The only
53		// signals strong enough to reclassify a real attempt are QUOTA and
54		// AUTH (definitive provider/account state) — never SETUP or PROVIDER
55		// transport, whose regexes match the wrapper bash script and verifier
56		// output ("eof" matches heredoc <<EOF markers; "timeout" matches task
57		// content; "permission denied" matches chmod fallbacks; etc.).
58		hasAttempt := matrixHasMeaningfulAttempt(report)
59		signal := matrixInvalidSignalBlob(report)
60		if hasAttempt {
61			// Only high-precision signals are trustworthy on real attempts.
62			// Broad SETUP/PROVIDER patterns false-positive on wrapper bash
63			// content and verifier output — see pattern doc-comments above.
64			if matrixInvalidQuotaPattern.MatchString(signal) {
65				return matrixInvalidQuota
66			}
67			if matrixInvalidAuthPattern.MatchString(signal) {
68				return matrixInvalidAuth
69			}
70			if matrixInvalidSetupDefinitivePattern.MatchString(signal) {
71				return matrixInvalidSetup
72			}
73		} else if class := classifyMatrixInvalidText(signal); class != "" {
74			return class
75		}
76		switch report.FinalStatus {
77		case "verifier_fail":
78			return ""
79		case "install_fail_permanent", "install_failed":
80			return matrixInvalidSetup
81		case "harness_crash":
82			// The agent runtime / wrapper crashed before producing a graded
83			// outcome. By definition systemic — usually per-trial timeout,
84			// docker subnet exhaustion, or external cancellation. Tag as
85			// invalid_setup so it doesn't pollute pass-rate denominators.
86			return matrixInvalidSetup
87		case "ran":
88			// final_status="ran" + ungraded + no meaningful attempt means the
89			// harbor wrapper exited cleanly but the trial never actually ran
90			// the agent — typically docker image pull failure, environment
91			// setup error, or other pre-agent infra issue. The actual exception
92			// lives in a side-file (exception.txt), not in the report's error
93			// blob (which only carries the harbor summary table), so the text
94			// classifier can't see it. The structural signal is enough.
95			if !hasAttempt && (report.GradingOutcome == "" || report.GradingOutcome == "ungraded") {
96				return matrixInvalidSetup
97			}
98		case "graded_fail":
99			// Conservative quality-attribution rule: a graded_fail with no
100			// meaningful agent attempt (zero turns, zero output tokens) is
101			// almost certainly a harness/provider/setup failure that Harbor
102			// happened to verify cleanly with reward=0. Sub-classify so the
103			// matrix tells these apart:
104			//   - had_llm_request=true + no response → provider hung/errored
105			//     (5xx, rate limit drop, stream closed before token). This is
106			//     a *provider* failure, retriable via --retry-invalid. The
107			//     model itself never got to try.
108			//   - had_llm_request=false / unknown → never reached the model
109			//     (setup error before request). Stays invalid_setup.
110			if !hasAttempt {
111				if report.HadLLMRequest != nil && *report.HadLLMRequest &&
112					(report.TerminatedMidWork == nil) {
113					return matrixInvalidProvider
114				}
115				return matrixInvalidSetup
116			}
117			// Even with some turns, if output tokens are zero AND wall is
118			// suspiciously short (<30s) we treat it as harness-level — the
119			// model never produced usable tokens, so reward=0 isn't a model
120			// quality signal. Threshold tuned so genuinely hard tasks where
121			// the model thinks-then-fails-fast still graded_fail correctly.
122			if intValue(report.OutputTokens) == 0 && intValue(report.Turns) <= 2 {
123				if w := report.WallSeconds; w != nil && *w < 30 {
124					return matrixInvalidSetup
125				}
126			}
127			return ""
128		}
129		return ""
130	}
131	
132	// classifyMatrixInvalidText is the no-meaningful-attempt path: when the
133	// agent never produced tokens, the broad SETUP / PROVIDER patterns become
134	// safe to apply (the error blob is dominated by infrastructure messages
135	// rather than wrapper bash + task content).
136	func classifyMatrixInvalidText(blob string) string {
137		blob = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(blob))
138		if blob == "" {
139			return ""
140		}
141		switch {
142		case matrixInvalidQuotaPattern.MatchString(blob):
143			return matrixInvalidQuota
144		case matrixInvalidAuthPattern.MatchString(blob):
145			return matrixInvalidAuth
146		case matrixInvalidSetupDefinitivePattern.MatchString(blob),
147			matrixInvalidSetupBroadPattern.MatchString(blob):
148			return matrixInvalidSetup
149		case matrixInvalidProviderPattern.MatchString(blob):
150			return matrixInvalidProvider
151		default:
152			return ""
153		}
154	}
155	
156	func isMatrixKnownInvalidClass(status string) bool {
157		switch status {
158		case matrixInvalidQuota, matrixInvalidAuth, matrixInvalidSetup, matrixInvalidProvider:
159			return true
160		default:
161			return false
162		}
163	}

165	func matrixHasMeaningfulAttempt(report matrixRunReport) bool {
166		return intValue(report.Turns) > 0 ||
167			intValue(report.ToolCalls) > 0 ||
168			intValue(report.ToolCallErrors) > 0 ||
169			intValue(report.InputTokens) > 0 ||
170			intValue(report.OutputTokens) > 0 ||
171			intValue(report.CachedInputTokens) > 0 ||
172			intValue(report.RetriedInputTokens) > 0
173	}
174	
175	func matrixInvalidSignalBlob(report matrixRunReport) string {
176		parts := []string{
177			report.Error,
178			report.ProcessOutcome,
179			report.FinalStatus,
180			strings.Join(report.AdapterTranslationNotes, " "),
181			strings.Join(report.Command, " "),
182		}
183		var out []string
184		for _, part := range parts {
185			part = strings.TrimSpace(part)
186			if part != "" {
187				out = append(out, part)
188			}
189		}
190		return strings.ToLower(strings.Join(out, "\n"))
191	}

25	# Mirror cmd/bench/matrix_invalid.go regex patterns.

32	KNOWN_CLASSES = {"invalid_quota", "invalid_auth", "invalid_setup", "invalid_provider"}

35	def has_meaningful_attempt(r: dict) -> bool:
36	    for k in ("turns", "tool_calls", "tool_call_errors", "input_tokens",
37	              "output_tokens", "cached_input_tokens", "retried_input_tokens"):
38	        v = r.get(k)
39	        if v is not None and v > 0:
40	            return True
41	    return False

44	def signal_blob(r: dict) -> str:
45	    parts = [r.get("error", ""), r.get("process_outcome", ""), r.get("final_status", "")]
46	    notes = r.get("adapter_translation_notes")
47	    if isinstance(notes, list):
48	        parts.append(" ".join(notes))
49	    cmd = r.get("command")
50	    if isinstance(cmd, list):
51	        parts.append(" ".join(cmd))
52	    return "\n".join(p.strip() for p in parts if p and p.strip()).lower()

55	def classify(r: dict) -> str:
56	    """Return the new invalid_class for this report, or '' if not invalid."""
57	    fs = r.get("final_status", "")
58	    if fs == "graded_pass":
59	        return ""
60	    if fs in KNOWN_CLASSES:
61	        return fs
62	    # Pre-existing invalid_class is NOT preserved here — we're reclassifying
63	    # from scratch using the new logic. That's the whole point of this pass.
64	    has_attempt = has_meaningful_attempt(r)
65	    blob = signal_blob(r)
66	    if has_attempt:
67	        if QUOTA.search(blob):
68	            return "invalid_quota"
69	        if AUTH.search(blob):
70	            return "invalid_auth"
71	        if SETUP_DEFINITIVE.search(blob):
72	            return "invalid_setup"
73	    else:
74	        if QUOTA.search(blob):
75	            return "invalid_quota"
76	        if AUTH.search(blob):
77	            return "invalid_auth"
78	        if SETUP_DEFINITIVE.search(blob) or SETUP_BROAD.search(blob):
79	            return "invalid_setup"
80	        if PROVIDER.search(blob):
81	            return "invalid_provider"
82	    if fs == "verifier_fail":
83	        return ""
84	    if fs in ("install_fail_permanent", "install_failed"):
85	        return "invalid_setup"
86	    if fs == "harness_crash":
87	        # Mirror Go: agent runtime crash before grading is systemic.
88	        return "invalid_setup"
89	    if fs == "ran" and not has_attempt and r.get("grading_outcome") in (None, "", "ungraded"):
90	        # Mirror Go: final_status="ran" + ungraded + no attempt = harbor
91	        # wrapper exited but trial never ran (docker pull fail, env setup
92	        # error, etc.). Exception lives in a side-file, not report.error.
93	        return "invalid_setup"
94	    if fs == "graded_fail":
95	        if not has_attempt:
96	            # Sub-classify: provider hang (request fired, no response) vs
97	            # setup failure (never reached the model). Mirrors Go classifier.
98	            if r.get("had_llm_request") is True and r.get("terminated_mid_work") is None:
99	                return "invalid_provider"
100	            return "invalid_setup"
101	        if (r.get("output_tokens") or 0) == 0 and (r.get("turns") or 0) <= 2:
102	            wall = r.get("wall_seconds")
103	            if wall is not None and wall < 30:
104	                return "invalid_setup"
105	        return ""
106	    return ""

109	def main() -> int:
110	    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__.split("\n", 1)[0])
111	    ap.add_argument("--dry-run", action="store_true", help="Don't write changes; just report deltas.")
112	    args = ap.parse_args()
113	
114	    paths = glob.glob(f"{CELLS}/*/*/*/rep-*/report.json")
115	    deltas = []
116	    unchanged = 0
117	    for p in paths:
118	        try:
119	            r = json.load(open(p))
120	        except Exception as e:
121	            print(f"  WARN: skip unreadable {p}: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
122	            continue
123	        old = r.get("invalid_class", "") or ""
124	        new = classify(r)
125	        if old == new:
126	            unchanged += 1
127	            continue
128	        deltas.append((p, old, new, r))
129	    print(f"scanned {len(paths)} reports", file=sys.stderr)
130	    print(f"unchanged: {unchanged}", file=sys.stderr)
131	    print(f"would change: {len(deltas)}", file=sys.stderr)
132	    from collections import Counter
133	    transitions = Counter((old or "(empty)", new or "(empty)") for _, old, new, _ in deltas)
134	    print("transition counts:", file=sys.stderr)
135	    for (old, new), n in transitions.most_common():
136	        print(f"  {old:20s} → {new:20s}  {n:>4}", file=sys.stderr)
137	
138	    if args.dry_run:
139	        return 0
140	
141	    for p, _, new, r in deltas:
142	        if new:
143	            r["invalid_class"] = new
144	        else:
145	            r.pop("invalid_class", None)
146	        Path(p).write_text(json.dumps(r, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
147	    print(f"wrote {len(deltas)} updated report.json files", file=sys.stderr)
148	    return 0
149	
150	
151	if __name__ == "__main__":
152	    sys.exit(main())

183		if err := fs.Parse(args); err != nil {
184			return 2
185		}

193		}

200		// itself is signaled (Ctrl-C or `kill <pid>`) the parent ctx fires,
201		// propagating cancellation into every per-tuple Harbor invocation. Each
202		// Harbor child then gets SIGTERM via cmd.Cancel + WaitDelay, has 60s
203		// to tear down its docker compose stack, and exits cleanly. Without
204		// this, killing bench leaves Harbor children running with their task
205		// containers (the leak we saw earlier in the session).
206		parentCtx, stopSignals := signal.NotifyContext(context.Background(), os.Interrupt, syscall.SIGTERM)

217		// inside the canonical fiz-tools-v<N>/ root. When --cells-root is unset,
218		// share the canonical /cells subtree. Tests that pass an explicit --out
219		// (typically a t.TempDir()) opt out via --cells-root staying empty,
220		// which falls through to the legacy in-place fallback (matrixTupleDir
221		// under outDir/cells/...). That preserves test isolation without

258		}

260		// Resolve harbor binary if tasks-dir is set (enables graded runs via Docker).
261		resolvedTasksDir := *tasksDir
262		if resolvedTasksDir != "" && !filepath.IsAbs(resolvedTasksDir) {
263			resolvedTasksDir = filepath.Join(wd, resolvedTasksDir)

265		harborBin := ""

269			} else {
270				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%s matrix: --tasks-dir set but harbor not found on PATH\n", benchCommandName())
271				return 1
272			}
273		}
274	
275		// Build the full list of tuples to run.
276		type tupleSpec struct {
277			harness string
278			prof    *profile.Profile
279			rep     int
280			task    termbenchSubsetEntry
281		}
282		var tuples []tupleSpec
283		for _, harness := range harnesses {
284			for _, prof := range profiles {
285				for rep := 1; rep <= *reps; rep++ {
286					for _, task := range subsetData.Tasks {
287						tuples = append(tuples, tupleSpec{harness, prof, rep, task})
288					}
289				}
290			}
291		}
292	
293		concurrency := *jobs
294		if concurrency < 1 {
295			concurrency = 1
296		}
297	
298		type tupleResult struct {
299			report  matrixRunReport
300			skipped bool
301			err     error
302		}
303	
304		results := make([]tupleResult, len(tuples))
305		sem := make(chan struct{}, concurrency)
306	
307		var (
308			mu              sync.Mutex
309			accumulatedCost float64
310			firstErr        error
311		)
312	
313		var wg sync.WaitGroup
314		for i, spec := range tuples {
315			wg.Add(1)
316			go func(i int, spec tupleSpec) {
317				defer wg.Done()
318				sem <- struct{}{}
319				defer func() { <-sem }()
320	
321				mu.Lock()
322				cost := accumulatedCost
323				mu.Unlock()
324	
325				report, skipped, err := runMatrixTuple(matrixTupleOptions{
326					workDir:           wd,
327					outDir:            outDir,
328					cellsRoot:         cellRootDir,
329					harness:           spec.harness,

341					tasksDir:          resolvedTasksDir,
342					harborBin:         harborBin,
343					extraEnv:          extraEnvMap(extraEnv),
344				})

346				mu.Lock()
347				results[i] = tupleResult{report, skipped, err}
348				if err != nil && firstErr == nil {
349					firstErr = err
350				}
351				if err == nil && !skipped {
352					accumulatedCost += report.CostUSD

355			}(i, spec)

359		if firstErr != nil {

362		}

376			Harnesses:       harnesses,
377			Reps:            *reps,
378			BudgetUSD:       *budgetUSD,
379			PerRunBudgetUSD: *perRunBudgetUSD,
380			Runs:            runs,
381			Cells:           summarizeMatrixCells(runs),
382			Notes: []string{
383				fmt.Sprintf("concurrency: --jobs %d", concurrency),
384				"adapter_module records the Python adapter path passed by the runner for the harness cell.",
385			},
386		}
387		matrixPath := filepath.Join(outDir, "matrix.json")
388		if err := writeJSONAtomic(matrixPath, output); err != nil {
389			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%s matrix: write matrix.json: %v\n", benchCommandName(), err)
390			return 1

420		if !opts.forceRerun {
421			if existing, ok, err := loadExistingMatrixReport(reportPath); err != nil {
422				return matrixRunReport{}, false, err
423			} else if ok && shouldSkipMatrixReport(existing, opts.resume, opts.retryBudgetHalted, opts.retryInvalid) {
424				return existing, true, nil
425			}
426		}
427	
428		release, err := acquireMatrixLock(filepath.Join(cellDir, matrixLockName))
429		if err != nil {
430			return matrixRunReport{}, false, err
431		}
432		defer release()
433	
434		started := time.Now().UTC()
435		report := matrixRunReport{
436			Harness:         opts.harness,
437			ProfileID:       opts.profile.ID,
438			ProfilePath:     opts.profile.Path,
439			ProfileSnapshot: opts.profile.Versioning.Snapshot,
440			FizToolsVersion: fiztools.Version,
441			AdapterModule:   matrixAdapterModule(opts.harness),
442			HarborAgent:     filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Join("scripts", "benchmark", "harness_adapters", moduleFileName(opts.harness))) + ":Agent",
443			Rep:             opts.rep,
444			TaskID:          opts.task.ID,
445			Category:        opts.task.Category,
446			Difficulty:      opts.task.Difficulty,
447			OutputDir:       cellDir,
448			StartedAt:       started,
449			PricingSource:   profilePricingSource(opts.profile),
450			SamplingUsed:    samplingUsedFromProfile(opts.profile),
451			ModelServerInfo: queryModelServerInfo(opts.profile),
452		}
453	
454		if opts.budgetUSD > 0 && opts.accumulatedCost >= opts.budgetUSD {
455			report.ProcessOutcome = "budget_halted"
456			report.GradingOutcome = "ungraded"
457			report.FinalStatus = deriveMatrixFinalStatus(report.ProcessOutcome, report.GradingOutcome, report.Reward, false)
458			report.FinishedAt = time.Now().UTC()
459			if err := writeJSONAtomic(reportPath, report); err != nil {
460				return matrixRunReport{}, false, err
461			}
462			return report, false, nil
463		}
464	
465		workDir := filepath.Join(cellDir, "work")
466		if err := os.MkdirAll(workDir, 0o750); err != nil {
467			return matrixRunReport{}, false, fmt.Errorf("create tuple workdir: %w", err)
468		}
469	
470		if opts.harborBin != "" {
471			taskPath, err := resolveMatrixTaskPath(opts.tasksDir, opts.task.ID)
472			if err != nil {
473				report.ProcessOutcome = "install_fail_permanent"
474				report.GradingOutcome = "ungraded"
475				report.Error = err.Error()
476			} else {
477				// Remove any stale Harbor job dir from a prior run before we
478				// invoke harbor again. Harbor (re)creates fiz-<task>-rep<N>/
479				// inside --jobs-dir; if a stale subdir exists from an earlier
480				// run with a different --tasks-dir, Harbor's config.json there
481				// references paths that may no longer exist (or that point at
482				// since-deleted timestamp dirs), and the trial fails with
483				// confusing errors. Wiping ensures a clean Harbor invocation
484				// every retry.
485				jobName := fmt.Sprintf("%s-%s-rep%d", opts.harness, opts.task.ID, opts.rep)
486				staleJobDir := filepath.Join(cellDir, jobName)
487				if _, err := os.Stat(staleJobDir); err == nil {
488					_ = os.RemoveAll(staleJobDir)
489				}
490				harborResult, err := runMatrixHarbor(harborRunOpts{
491					harborBin: opts.harborBin,
492					taskPath:  taskPath,
493					harness:   opts.harness,
494					profile:   opts.profile,
495					jobsDir:   cellDir,
496					jobName:   jobName,
497					repoRoot:  opts.workDir,
498					extraEnv:  opts.extraEnv,
499					parentCtx: opts.parentCtx,
500				})
501				if err != nil {
502					report.ProcessOutcome = "harness_crash"
503					report.GradingOutcome = "ungraded"
504					report.Error = err.Error()
505				} else {
506					report.ExitCode = harborResult.exitCode
507					report.Error = harborResult.errText
508					seconds := harborResult.wallSeconds
509					report.WallSeconds = &seconds
510					if harborResult.inputTokens != nil {
511						report.InputTokens = harborResult.inputTokens
512					}
513					if harborResult.outputTokens != nil {
514						report.OutputTokens = harborResult.outputTokens
515					}
516					if harborResult.turns != nil {
517						report.Turns = harborResult.turns
518					}
519					report.CostUSD = harborResult.costUSD
520					if harborResult.reward != nil {
521						report.Reward = harborResult.reward
522						report.GradingOutcome = "graded"
523						report.ProcessOutcome = "completed"
524					} else if harborResult.exitCode != 0 {
525						report.ProcessOutcome = "harness_crash"
526						report.GradingOutcome = "ungraded"
527					} else {
528						report.ProcessOutcome = "completed"
529						report.GradingOutcome = "ungraded"
530					}
531				}
532				// Read session-jsonl signals (terminated_mid_work + had_llm_request)
533				// from the trial's session jsonl. The harbor agent (FizeauAgent)
534				// writes to <cellDir>/<jobName>/<trial-hash>/agent/sessions/
535				// svc-*.jsonl; glob for the newest since the trial-hash isn't
536				// known up front. Mirrors backfill-terminated-mid-work.py.
537				tmw, hadReq := readSessionSignalsFromCell(filepath.Join(cellDir, jobName))
538				if tmw != nil {
539					report.TerminatedMidWork = tmw
540				}
541				report.HadLLMRequest = &hadReq
542			}
543		} else {
544			result, err := runMatrixAdapter(opts.workDir, report.AdapterModule, opts.profile, matrixPrompt(opts.task), opts.task.ID, workDir)
545			if err != nil {
546				report.ProcessOutcome = "harness_crash"
547				report.GradingOutcome = "ungraded"
548				report.Error = err.Error()
549			} else {
550				report.Command = result.Command.Argv
551				report.AdapterTranslationNotes = append(report.AdapterTranslationNotes, result.Apply.Notes...)
552				report.AdapterTranslationNotes = append(report.AdapterTranslationNotes, result.Command.Notes...)
553				report.ExitCode = result.ExitCode
554				if result.ExitCode != 0 {
555					report.ProcessOutcome = "harness_crash"
556					report.Error = strings.TrimSpace(result.Stderr)
557				}
558				applyTelemetry(&report, result.Telemetry)
559				if report.WallSeconds == nil && result.Duration >= 0 {
560					seconds := float64(result.Duration) / 1000
561					report.WallSeconds = &seconds
562				}
563			}
564		}
565		if report.ProcessOutcome == "" {
566			report.ProcessOutcome = "completed"
567		}
568		if report.GradingOutcome == "" {
569			report.GradingOutcome = "ungraded"
570		}
571		if report.Reward != nil && report.GradingOutcome == "ungraded" {
572			report.GradingOutcome = "graded"
573		}
574		report.CostUSD = matrixCostUSD(opts.profile, report)
575		if (opts.perRunBudgetUSD > 0 && report.CostUSD > opts.perRunBudgetUSD) ||
576			(opts.budgetUSD > 0 && opts.accumulatedCost+report.CostUSD > opts.budgetUSD) {
577			report.ProcessOutcome = "budget_halted"
578			report.GradingOutcome = "ungraded"
579			report.Reward = nil
580		}
581		report.FinalStatus = deriveMatrixFinalStatus(report.ProcessOutcome, report.GradingOutcome, report.Reward, report.Retriable)
582		report.InvalidClass = classifyMatrixInvalid(report)
583		report.FinishedAt = time.Now().UTC()
584		if err := writeJSONAtomic(reportPath, report); err != nil {
585			return matrixRunReport{}, false, err
586		}
587		return report, false, nil
588	}

590	func resolveMatrixTaskPath(tasksDir, taskID string) (string, error) {
591		candidates := []string{
592			filepath.Join(tasksDir, taskID),
593			filepath.Join(tasksDir, "terminal-bench", taskID),
594		}
595		for _, candidate := range candidates {
596			if isMatrixTaskDir(candidate) {
597				return candidate, nil
598			}
599		}
600	
601		nestedRoot := filepath.Join(tasksDir, "terminal-bench", taskID)
602		entries, err := os.ReadDir(nestedRoot)
603		if err == nil {
604			var matches []string
605			for _, entry := range entries {
606				if !entry.IsDir() {
607					continue
608				}
609				path := filepath.Join(nestedRoot, entry.Name())
610				if isMatrixTaskDir(path) {
611					matches = append(matches, path)
612				}
613			}
614			if len(matches) == 1 {
615				return matches[0], nil
616			}
617			if len(matches) > 1 {
618				sort.Strings(matches)
619				return "", fmt.Errorf("multiple task digests found for %s under %s", taskID, nestedRoot)
620			}
621		}
622	
623		return "", fmt.Errorf("task directory not found for %s under %s", taskID, tasksDir)
624	}

672	func runMatrixHarbor(opts harborRunOpts) (harborRunResult, error) {
673		started := time.Now()
674	
675		apiKeyEnv := opts.profile.Provider.APIKeyEnv
676		if override := strings.TrimSpace(opts.extraEnv["FIZEAU_API_KEY_ENV"]); override != "" {
677			apiKeyEnv = override
678		}
679		apiKeyVal := resolveMatrixAPIKey(opts.repoRoot, opts.profile, apiKeyEnv)
680	
681		args := []string{"run", "--yes", "--path", opts.taskPath}
682		args = append(args, harborAgentArgs(opts.harness)...)
683		args = append(args,
684			"--model", opts.profile.Provider.Model,
685			"--jobs-dir", opts.jobsDir,
686			"--job-name", opts.jobName,
687		)
688		if truthyEnv("HARBOR_FORCE_BUILD") {
689			args = append(args, "--force-build")
690		}
691		// Agent timeout multiplier resolution order (later wins):
692		//   1. Profile YAML's agent_timeout_multiplier (per-lane default)
693		//   2. HARBOR_AGENT_TIMEOUT_MULTIPLIER env var (per-invocation override)
694		// Slow local engines (oMLX, vLLM-int4) bake their multiplier into the
695		// profile so individual sweeps don't have to remember to set the env
696		// var. Without this, those lanes truncate mid-tool-call on hard tasks.
697		multiplier := ""
698		if m := opts.profile.AgentTimeoutMultiplier; m > 0 {
699			multiplier = strconv.FormatFloat(m, 'f', -1, 64)
700		}
701		if env := strings.TrimSpace(os.Getenv("HARBOR_AGENT_TIMEOUT_MULTIPLIER")); env != "" {
702			multiplier = env
703		}
704		if multiplier != "" {
705			args = append(args, "--agent-timeout-multiplier", multiplier)
706		}
707		// Do not pass actual API key values through Harbor --ae args. Harbor
708		// includes those args in process listings and exception logs. The Fizeau
709		// Harbor agent resolves FIZEAU_API_KEY_ENV from the Harbor process
710		// environment instead.
711		// Pass provider config so Harbor agents can configure the model endpoint.
712		args = append(args,
713			"--ae", "FIZEAU_BASE_URL="+opts.profile.Provider.BaseURL,
714			"--ae", "FIZEAU_MODEL="+opts.profile.Provider.Model,
715			"--ae", "FIZEAU_PROVIDER="+fizeauProviderEnv(opts.profile),
716		)

834	func harborFailureText(jobOutDir, combined string) string {
835		var parts []string
836		if s := strings.TrimSpace(combined); s != "" {
837			parts = append(parts, s)
838		}
839		_ = filepath.WalkDir(jobOutDir, func(path string, d os.DirEntry, err error) error {
840			if err != nil || d.IsDir() {
841				return nil
842			}
843			base := filepath.Base(path)
844			if base != "fiz.txt" && base != "exception.txt" {
845				return nil
846			}
847			data, err := os.ReadFile(path) // #nosec G304 G122 -- path is under runner-owned output dir; WalkDir TOCTOU acceptable for postprocess scan
848			if err != nil {
849				return nil
850			}
851			text := strings.TrimSpace(string(data))
852			if text != "" {
853				parts = append(parts, text)
854			}
855			return nil
856		})
857		text := redactBenchmarkSecrets(strings.Join(parts, "\n"))
858		if len(text) > 4000 {
859			// Keep the tail: Python tracebacks place the actual exception
860			// (e.g. "RuntimeError: Docker compose command failed ...") at the end,
861			// and the framework noise above it is what we'd rather drop.
862			text = text[len(text)-4000:]
863		}
864		return strings.TrimSpace(text)
865	}

867	func redactBenchmarkSecrets(text string) string {
868		if text == "" {
869			return ""
870		}
871		patterns := []*regexp.Regexp{
872			regexp.MustCompile(`sk-[A-Za-z0-9_-]+`),
873			regexp.MustCompile(`(?i)(OPENAI_API_KEY|OPENROUTER_API_KEY|FIZEAU_API_KEY|ANTHROPIC_API_KEY)=\S+`),
874			regexp.MustCompile(`(?i)(api_key:\s*)\S+`),
875		}
876		out := text
877		for _, re := range patterns {
878			out = re.ReplaceAllStringFunc(out, func(match string) string {
879				if strings.Contains(match, "=") {
880					key, _, _ := strings.Cut(match, "=")
881					return key + "=<redacted>"
882				}
883				if strings.Contains(match, ":") {
884					key, _, _ := strings.Cut(match, ":")
885					return key + ": <redacted>"
886				}
887				return "<redacted>"
888			})
889		}
890		return out
891	}

1205	func acquireMatrixLock(path string) (func(), error) {
1206		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(path), 0o750); err != nil {
1207			return nil, err
1208		}
1209		lock := matrixLock{PID: os.Getpid(), StartedAt: time.Now().UTC()}
1210		raw, _ := json.Marshal(lock)
1211		for attempts := 0; attempts < 2; attempts++ {
1212			f, err := os.OpenFile(path, os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREATE|os.O_EXCL, 0o600) // #nosec G304 -- path is the matrix lock file path
1213			if err == nil {
1214				if _, werr := f.Write(raw); werr != nil {
1215					_ = f.Close()
1216					_ = os.Remove(path)
1217					return nil, werr
1218				}
1219				if err := f.Close(); err != nil {
1220					_ = os.Remove(path)
1221					return nil, err
1222				}
1223				return func() { _ = os.Remove(path) }, nil
1224			}
1225			if !errors.Is(err, os.ErrExist) {
1226				return nil, err
1227			}
1228			existing, readErr := readMatrixLock(path)
1229			if readErr == nil && !processAlive(existing.PID) {
1230				if removeErr := os.Remove(path); removeErr != nil && !errors.Is(removeErr, os.ErrNotExist) {
1231					return nil, fmt.Errorf("remove stale lock %s: %w", path, removeErr)
1232				}
1233				continue
1234			}
1235			pid := "unknown"
1236			if readErr == nil && existing.PID > 0 {
1237				pid = strconv.Itoa(existing.PID)
1238			}
1239			return nil, fmt.Errorf("matrix tuple locked by pid %s: %s", pid, path)
1240		}
1241		return nil, fmt.Errorf("could not acquire matrix tuple lock: %s", path)
1242	}
